ticket.title: chalkline docs check exits zero even when documents have drifted
ticket.description: Found while building GB-168: chalkline docs check reports drifted documents in its summary but still exits 0, so a gate that relies on the exit code marks the docs step green while a document is drifted. Observed directly - outfeed reported 1 drifted (the new GateReport type) and the gate step passed; after documenting the type the drift went to 0 with the same exit code. The docs step needs a non-zero exit when missing or drifted counts are non-zero, or outfeed gate must parse the summary, which is the weaker option.

verification_receipt.summary: Closed on chalkline main at 636ed4a, developed on fix/docs-check-exit-code with the lease taken before the edit. The workspace audit path already errored on violations while the single-repository path printed its summary and returned Ok, so callers that gate on the exit code - including outfeed gate step 6 - saw green with drift in the summary. Both paths now fail with the counts named. Verified live both ways: outfeed at 9 present, 0 missing, 0 drifted exits 0, and a probe workspace with a Cargo.toml and one undocumented public type reports 'Summary: 1 present, 5 missing, 0 drifted' then 'Error: Documentation audit failed: 5 missing, 0 drifted'. Gates: fmt clean, clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean, nextest 23/23.
